verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἄγγελον καταβαίνοντα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔχοντα τὴν κλεῖν τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ ἅλυσιν μεγάλην ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai eidon angelon katabainonta ek tou ouranou echonta tēn klein tēs abyssou kai halysin megalēn epi tēn cheira autou
verses.literal: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the Abyss holding in his hand a great chain

verses.original: καὶ ἐκράτησεν τὸν δράκοντα ὁ ὄφις ὁ ἀρχαῖος ὅς ἐστιν Διάβολος καὶ Ὁ Σατανᾶς καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτὸν χίλια ἔτη
verses.transliteration: kai ekratēsen ton drakonta ho ophis ho archaios hos estin Diabolos kai HO Satanas kai edēsen auton chilia etē
verses.literal: He seized the dragon that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan and bound him for a thousand years

verses.original: καὶ ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν ἄβυσσον καὶ ἔκλεισεν καὶ ἐσφράγισεν ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ ἵνα μὴ πλανήσῃ ἔτι τὰ ἔθνη ἄχρι τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη μετὰ ταῦτα δεῖ λυθῆναι αὐτὸν μικρὸν χρόνον
verses.transliteration: kai ebalen auton eis tēn abysson kai ekleisen kai esphragisen epanō autou hina mē planēsē eti ta ethnē achri telesthē ta chilia etē meta tauta dei lythēnai auton mikron chronon
verses.literal: And he threw him into the Abyss shut it and sealed it over him so that he could not deceive . . . the nations until the thousand years were complete After that he must be released for a brief period of time

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον θρόνους καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐπ’ αὐτούς καὶ κρίμα ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς καὶ τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν πεπελεκισμένων διὰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ καὶ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ οἵτινες οὐ προσεκύνησαν τὸ θηρίον οὐδὲ τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔλαβον τὸ χάραγμα ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτῶν καὶ ἔζησαν καὶ ἐβασίλευσαν μετὰ τοῦ χριστοῦ χίλια ἔτη
verses.transliteration: Kai eidon thronous kai ekathisan ep’ autous kai krima edothē autois kai tas psychas tōn pepelekismenōn dia tēn martyrian Iēsou kai dia ton logon tou theou kai hoitines ou prosekynēsan to thērion oude tēn eikona autou kai ouk elabon to charagma epi to metōpon kai epi tēn cheira autōn kai ezēsan kai ebasileusan meta tou christou chilia etē
verses.literal: Then I saw the thrones and those seated on them had been given authority to judge And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or - hands And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years

verses.original: Οἱ λοιποὶ τῶν νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔζησαν ἄχρι τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη αὕτη ἡ ἀνάστασις ἡ πρώτη
verses.transliteration: Hoi loipoi tōn nekrōn ouk ezēsan achri telesthē ta chilia etē hautē hē anastasis hē prōtē
verses.literal: The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete This is the first resurrection

verses.original: μακάριος καὶ ἅγιος ὁ ἔχων μέρος ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τῇ πρώτῃ ἐπὶ τούτων ὁ δεύτερος θάνατος οὐκ ἔχει ἐξουσίαν ἀλλ’ ἔσονται ἱερεῖς τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν μετ’ αὐτοῦ τὰ χίλια ἔτη
verses.transliteration: makarios kai hagios ho echōn meros en tē anastasei tē prōtē epi toutōn ho deuteros thanatos ouk echei exousian all’ esontai hiereis tou Theou kai tou Christou kai basileusousin met’ autou ta chilia etē
verses.literal: Blessed and holy are those who share . . . in the first resurrection The second death has no power over them but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with Him for a thousand years

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη λυθήσεται ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐκ τῆς φυλακῆς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan telesthē ta chilia etē lythēsetai ho Satanas ek tēs phylakēs autou
verses.literal: When the thousand years are complete Satan will be released from his prison

verses.original: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται πλανῆσαι τὰ ἔθνη τὰ ἐν ταῖς τέσσαρσιν γωνίαις τῆς γῆς τὸν Γὼγ καὶ Μαγώγ συναγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν πόλεμον ὧν ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης
verses.transliteration: kai exeleusetai planēsai ta ethnē ta en tais tessarsin gōniais tēs gēs ton Gōg kai Magōg synagagein autous eis ton polemon hōn ho arithmos autōn hōs hē ammos tēs thalassēs
verses.literal: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth Gog and Magog to assemble them for battle Their number is like the sand of the seashore

verses.original: Καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὸ πλάτος τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκύκλευσαν τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν ἁγίων καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἠγαπημένην καὶ κατέβη πῦρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai anebēsan epi to platos tēs gēs kai ekykleusan tēn parembolēn tōn hagiōn kai tēn polin tēn ēgapēmenēn kai katebē pyr ek tou ouranou kai katephagen autous
verses.literal: And they marched across . . . the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city But fire came down from heaven and consumed them

verses.original: καὶ ὁ διάβολος ὁ πλανῶν αὐτοὺς ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρὸς καὶ θείου ὅπου καὶ τὸ θηρίον καὶ ὁ ψευδοπροφήτης καὶ βασανισθήσονται ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων
verses.transliteration: kai ho diabolos ho planōn autous eblēthē eis tēn limnēn tou pyros kai theiou hopou kai to thērion kai ho pseudoprophētēs kai basanisthēsontai hēmeras kai nyktos eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn
verses.literal: And the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur into which the beast and the false prophet had already been thrown There they will be tormented day and night forever . . . . . . and ever

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον θρόνον μέγαν λευκὸν καὶ τὸν καθήμενον ἐπ’ αὐτόν οὗ ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου ἔφυγεν ἡ γῆ καὶ ὁ οὐρανός καὶ τόπος οὐχ εὑρέθη αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai eidon thronon megan leukon kai ton kathēmenon ep’ auton hou apo tou prosōpou ephygen hē gē kai ho ouranos kai topos ouch heurethē autois
verses.literal: Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it Earth and heaven fled from His presence and no place was found for them

verses.original: καὶ εἶδον τοὺς νεκρούς τοὺς μεγάλους καὶ τοὺς μικρούς ἑστῶτας ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου καὶ βιβλία ἠνοίχθησαν Καὶ ἄλλο βιβλίον ἠνοίχθη ὅ ἐστιν τῆς ζωῆς καὶ ἐκρίθησαν οἱ νεκροὶ ἐκ τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τοῖς βιβλίοις κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai eidon tous nekrous tous megalous kai tous mikrous hestōtas enōpion tou thronou kai biblia ēnoichthēsan Kai allo biblion ēnoichthē ho estin tēs zōēs kai ekrithēsan hoi nekroi ek tōn gegrammenōn en tois bibliois kata ta erga autōn
verses.literal: And I saw the dead great and small standing before the throne And books were opened and one of them was - the Book of Life And the dead were judged according to their deeds as recorded in the books

verses.original: καὶ ἔδωκεν ἡ θάλασσα τοὺς νεκροὺς τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ὁ θάνατος καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἔδωκαν τοὺς νεκροὺς τοὺς ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκρίθησαν ἕκαστος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai edōken hē thalassa tous nekrous tous en autē kai ho thanatos kai ho hadēs edōkan tous nekrous tous en autois kai ekrithēsan hekastos kata ta erga autōn
verses.literal: The sea gave up its dead and Death and Hades gave up their dead . . . . . . . . . and each one was judged according to his deeds

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ θάνατος καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἐβλήθησαν εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρός οὗτος ὁ θάνατος ὁ δεύτερός ἐστιν ἡ λίμνη τοῦ πυρός
verses.transliteration: Kai ho thanatos kai ho hadēs eblēthēsan eis tēn limnēn tou pyros houtos ho thanatos ho deuteros estin hē limnē tou pyros
verses.literal: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire This is the second death the lake of fire

verses.original: καὶ εἴ τις οὐχ εὑρέθη ἐν τῇ βίβλῳ τῆς ζωῆς γεγραμμένος ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρός
verses.transliteration: kai ei tis ouch heurethē en tē biblō tēs zōēs gegrammenos eblēthē eis tēn limnēn tou pyros
verses.literal: And if anyone was found whose name was not written . . . in the Book of Life he was thrown into the lake of fire
